payload.title: L1: Live round 1 for all arms on dev-100 (bound ~2,450) -> STOP 1
payload.description:
## Purpose

First live reading of arms 0, A-c, F, F-rand and A-c+F on Emotion.

## Scope

Round 1 (150 labels), all arms scored on dev-100.

## Request bound and cost cap

Bound ~2,450 Jev requests (use the printed bound). Cap: ~$2.50. Fresh ledger for this stage; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class. Counts toward the hard cumulative cap of $10.

## Stop-point checks

**STOP 1** (owner looks): are A-c's elements sensible; did the feature cap fire; did the labeler comment on most items. No L2 until the owner says go.

## Definition of done

Dev-100 table per arm (macro-F1, acc, per-class recall); elements and dropped elements listed; actual spend.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
